title: GLL: A Differentiable Graph Learning Layer for Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2412.08016v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Standard deep learning architectures used for classification generate label predictions with a projection head and softmax activation function. Although successful, these methods fail to leverage the relational information between samples for generating label predictions. In recent works, graph-based learning techniques, namely Laplace learning, have been heuristically combined with neural networks for both supervised and semi-supervised learning (SSL) tasks. However, prior works approximate the gradient of the loss function with respect to the graph learning algorithm or decouple the processes; end-to-end integration with neural networks is not achieved. In this work, we derive backpropagation equations, via the adjoint method, for inclusion of a general family of graph learning layers into a neural network. translated_title: GLL：一种面向神经网络的可微图学习层
translated_abstract: 标准的用于分类任务的深度学习架构通过投影头和softmax激活函数生成标签预测。尽管这些方法取得了成功，但它们未能利用样本之间的关系信息来生成标签预测。在近期的研究中，基于图的学习技术（即拉普拉斯学习）已被启发式地与神经网络结合，用于有监督和半监督学习（SSL）任务。然而，先前的工作要么对损失函数关于图学习算法的梯度进行近似，要么将这两个过程解耦处理，未能实现与神经网络的端到端集成。在这项工作中，我们通过伴随方法推导了反向传播方程，从而能够将一类通用的图学习层引入神经网络。所得方法不同于图神经网络，使我们能够精确地集成相似度图构建与...
tldr: 该论文通过伴随方法推导出反向传播方程，提出了可微图学习层GLL，实现了图学习算法与神经网络的端到端精确集成，从而在分类任务中利用样本间的关系信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GLL, a differentiable graph learning layer that derives backpropagation equations via the adjoint method, enabling precise end-to-end integration of graph learning with neural networks to leverage relational information between samples for classification.
